# Safe.Pharmacy

> > Safe.Pharmacy is the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy's (NABP) consumer protection program for verified online pharmacy safety and medication education.

Safe.Pharmacy helps consumers identify legitimate online pharmacies through .pharmacy domain verification, provides multilingual resources on medication safety and disposal, and offers tools to report suspicious pharmacy websites. The program emphasizes substance use disorder prevention, proper drug disposal through DEA collection sites, and pharmacist-assisted healthcare.

## Key Topics

- NABP (National Association of Boards of Pharmacy)
- .pharmacy domain verification
- Online pharmacy verification
- Medication safety
- Drug disposal and donation (SIRUM, SafeNetRx)
- Opioid safety and overdose prevention
- Substance use disorder prevention
- Consumer protection
- Pharmacy accreditation
- Safe Site Search Tool
- DEA drug take-back programs
- Pharmacist consultation services
- FDA medication guidelines
- Multilingual health resources (English, Spanish, French)

## Getting Started

- [Safe Pharmacy | Medication Safety | Protect Public Health | NABP](https://safe.pharmacy/about): About NABP's Safe Pharmacy program and .pharmacy domain accreditation
- [Farmacia Segura | Asociación Nacional de Juntas de Farmacia](https://safe.pharmacy/es): Spanish homepage for NABP's Safe Pharmacy program and resources
- [Farmacia Segura | Seguridad de los medicamentos | NABP](https://safe.pharmacy/es/acerca-de): Spanish about page for NABP Safe Pharmacy and .pharmacy domain

## Verify Safe Online Pharmacies

- [Trouvez des pharmacies en ligne sécurisées | Vérifié et approuvé](https://safe.pharmacy/fr/faites-vos-achats-en-toute-securite): French directory of NABP-verified safe online pharmacies

## Medication Safety & Education

- [Drug Abuse | Substance Use Disorder | Prevent Medication Misuse](https://safe.pharmacy/prevent-misuse): SUD warning signs and resources from SAMHSA and CDC for prevention
- [Consumo seguro de drogas | Farmacias ilegales en línea](https://safe.pharmacy/es/uso-seguro): Spanish guide on safe medication use, labels, and overdose prevention
- [6 sujets sur lesquels votre pharmacien peut vous aider](https://safe.pharmacy/fr/utilisation-securitaire/comment-les-pharmaciens-peuvent-vous-aider): French guide on 6 healthcare topics pharmacists can help with
- [6 temas con los que su farmacéutico puede ayudarle](https://safe.pharmacy/es/uso-seguro/como-puede-ayudar-los-farmaceuticos): Spanish guide on pharmacist assistance with medications and opioids
- [Pharmacists Manage Heart Health | Heart Health Month](https://safe.pharmacy/resources/blog/5-ways-pharmacists-can-help-you-manage-heart-health): Heart health management tips from pharmacists during American Heart Month

## Drug Disposal & Donation

- [Drug Disposal | Drug Disposal Locator Tool | Medication Disposal](https://safe.pharmacy/drug-disposal/drug-donation): Guide to prescription drug donation programs like SIRUM and SafeNetRx
- [Herramienta de localización de eliminación de medicamentos](https://safe.pharmacy/es/desecho-de-medicamentos): Spanish drug disposal locator tool for DEA collection sites
- [Donación de medicamentos | Eliminacion medica](https://safe.pharmacy/es/desecho-de-medicamentos/donacion-de-medicamentos): Spanish guide to medication donation programs like SIRUM and SafeNetRx

## Resources & Articles

- [Safe Pharmacy | Resources | Expert Articles | Online Purchase](https://safe.pharmacy/resources): Resources hub for medication safety, disposal, and misuse prevention
- [Farmacia segura | recursos | Articulos de expertos |compre en linea](https://safe.pharmacy/es/recursos): Spanish resources hub for medication safety and online pharmacy education

## Report Suspicious Sites

- [Pagina seguro | No recomendado | Informe](https://safe.pharmacy/es/reporte-un-sitio-web-sospechoso): Spanish form to report suspicious online pharmacy websites to NABP
- [Site Web securise | Non recommande | Rapport](https://safe.pharmacy/fr/signalez-un-site-web-douteux): French form to report suspicious pharmacy websites to NABP
